notes: 02: only title+description collected; no favicon or preview image. 03: title editable only after save (edit dialog), description not editable anywhere and no before-save edit step. 04: edit dialog covers url+title only; tags add-only via card, description not editable, note field does not exist. 07: title/description/tags shown but 'favicon' is an initials placeholder, not a favicon. 08: card title/address are plain text, click handler only reacts to buttons, so items never navigate to the url. 10: tag input is a plain field with no autocomplete/suggestions. 11: tag chips are non-clickable spans; no select-tag-to-filter mechanism. 12: search haystack is title+tags only, not description/note/url. 14: no #tag syntax handling. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses. 16: no quoted-phrase exact match. 20: no multi-select/bulk actions. 21: no whole-collection bulk apply. 22: no sort control. 23: no markdown note feature. 24: no local HTML snapshot / PDF handling. 25: no Internet Archive integration. 29: no bundles (saved filters). 30: no Netscape HTML import. 31: no Netscape HTML export. 32: no display/personal settings.
